questions.prompt: Confirm the grilled product scope (correct anything that is wrong).
questions.description: Already decided in chat. This is a check, not a restatement exercise.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Hard-major 2.0.0 readiness without tagging/publishing. Reshape existing tracks only. Tooling canon (uv/ruff/ty/just/pnpm/pytest/pre-commit/pydantic/loguru/typer/playwright/vitest) plus mise on maintainer and generated, OpenSpec maintainer-first and optional/off for generated apps, hypothesis+respx on generated Python tests. Full release ladder including render_matrix is blocking. Fold the current dirty tree. Super-good auto-migrate of known old Copier keys then fail-closed. Correctness then planned refine until dry. Required surfaces: payloads, riso CLI migrate, web wizard, docs, CI/gates.

options.label: Hard major 2.0: keys/CLI/layout may change; no tag or PyPI publish in this goal
No new languages, runtimes, or vendors
Canon stack + mise (maintainer and generated) + OpenSpec (maintainer + optional generated off by default)
Add hypothesis + respx to generated Python test extras
just quality, all sample validates, jinja, context/agents, full render_matrix, no-legacy answers, docs -W, release validators — all blocking
Start from current dirty tree; keep what matches, rewrite what fights
Auto-remap known removed keys with dry-run preview, tests, idempotence; then fail-closed; no dual-path
Correctness first, then planned DX/visual refine until dry
Payloads + CLI migrate + wizard + docs + gates must stay in lockstep

questions.prompt: How should work be ordered across agents?
questions.description: This repo already uses exclusive write lanes. Hard-major contract edits still serialize on copier.yml/hooks.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Reuse exclusive-write lanes. Wave 0 inventory dirty tree + removed-key map. Wave 1 COORD contracts/migration SSOT. Wave 2 parallel payload (PY/NODE/SAAS/SYS/DESKTOP) + CLI migrate + wizard. Wave 3 PLATFORM matrix/gates. Wave 4 docs + ASSURANCE evidence. Refine loops until two consecutive passes add no P0/P1.

options.label: Exclusive lanes: COORD/migrate first, then parallel payload+CLI+wizard, then PLATFORM matrix, then docs/assurance (Recommended)
One serial stream in this goal directory only
Polish payloads first; batch Copier/CLI contract changes late

questions.prompt: When does “planned refine until dry” stop?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Stop refine when two consecutive review passes find no new P0/P1 on required surfaces, and the full release ladder is green.

options.label: Two consecutive passes with no new P0/P1, and the full ladder green (Recommended)
Exactly one refine wave after correctness, then stop
Stop after a timebox even if P1s remain (you would set the box later)

questions.prompt: Keep or raise generated runtime floors for 2.0?
questions.description: Today: Python 3.11–3.13, Node 20+. Raising floors is a valid hard-major break.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Keep Python 3.11+ and Node 20+ unless a gate proves a higher floor is required. Do not drop 3.11 or Node 20 just for taste.
